Troubleshooting · 15/50 · color

Incorrect color-space tag

Failure signal

A incorrect color-space tag condition is reported or detected during color.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for color does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare file tags with the documented camera transform and measured appearance.

Corrective action

Correct metadata or transform pixels once; verify on a managed reference display.

Prevention

Add this verification to the color gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
